base_member_text: Cross-line: T_sum and T_sumUVmean are declared INTENT(OUT) (L103) but are read before being written (L116-117, L119, L200) - with INTENT(OUT) their values on entry are formally undefined in Fortran; the code relies on them behaving as INOUT.
audit_member_text: Use-before-definition: T_sum and T_sumUVmean are declared INTENT(OUT) at L103, but their incoming values are read on the right-hand sides of T_sum=T_sum+DT and T_sumUVmean=T_sumUVmean+DT at L116-L117. Fortran makes an INTENT(OUT) dummy undefined on entry, so both accumulation clocks start from undefined values unless the interface intent is corrected.

base_member_text: Division by real(NumDT1-1) (L127) and real(NumDT2-1) (L212) is unguarded; on the first finalize with NumDT1<=1 or NumDT2<=1 this divides by zero or is negative-weighted.
audit_member_text: The sample-variance formulas divide by NumDT1-1 at L127-L128 and NumDT2-1 at L212-L213, but their interval branches at L119 and L200 have no guard requiring either counter to exceed 1; the only explicit count resets are to zero at L134 and L223, so short/zero intervals can reach a zero or negative denominator.

base_member_text: File header comment still says 'FILE mixing.F' (L3) although this is mixing_salatin.F; relation to the plain mixing.F build variant (which file is compiled) is decided outside this file.

Cross-line mixed weighting: ETA2sum accumulates unweighted ETA^2 samples (L158-161) and is divided by count NumDT1 (L127-128), while ETAsum is DT-weighted and divided by time T_sum (L123-124); the variance formula therefore mixes a count-normalized second moment with a time-normalized mean, exact only for uniform DT. Same mixture in the vorticity branch: Vorsum is DT-weighted / T_sumUVmean (L207-209) but Vor2sum is count-based / NumDT2 (L212-213, L234-237); commented-out count-based Vorsum lines (L206, L208) show the alternative.
NumDT1=ZERO and NumDT2=ZERO assign the (presumably real) PARAM constant ZERO to INTEGER counters (L134, L223); ZERO is defined in USE PARAM outside this file.
Per-interval resets of Num_Zero_Up/HavgSum/HrmsSum are commented out (L144-146), so WaveHeightAve/RMS are cumulative since STEADY_TIME.
Vor_Instant is INTENT(INOUT) (L109) but only read here (L207, L231, L234); where it is computed is external to this file.

audit_member_text: SQRT is applied directly to cancellation-prone expanded variances at L131 and L214 without clamping or checking for a small negative roundoff result, which can produce invalid values even when the intended variance is nonnegative.
